answer.text:
According to Adobe Inc.'s fiscal 2024 Form 10-K:

### 1. Fiscal Year 2024 Total Digital Media Segment Revenue
* **$15,864 million** (or **$15.86 billion**)

### 2. Year-over-Year Percentage Growth from Fiscal 2023
* **Reported Growth:** **12%**
* **Calculation:**
  $$\frac{\$15,864\text{ million} - \$14,216\text{ million}}{\$14,216\text{ million}} = \frac{\$1,648\text{ million}}{\$14,216\text{ million}} \approx 11.59\% \rightarrow 12\%$$

*(Sources: Accession `0000796343-25-000004`, Section "Segments", Chunk ID `839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b`; Section "Digital Media", Chunk ID `b52db0a2-1d0b-53bc-9889-5dd847e0b67c`; and Section "NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS (Continued)", Chunk ID `065ae57a-28b6-5fda-a0e3-57c1a980d702`)*
